chunks: regarding the foetus: 'When it grows hair, then eat; or else do not eat — meaning if it has not grown hair.'

key_terms.أشعر: To grow hair; used as the juristic criterion for permissibility of the foetus
key_terms.الجنين: Foetus; the unborn young found in the womb of a slaughtered animal

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to eat the foetus found in a slaughtered animal's womb?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) issued a ruling on eating the foetus found in the womb of a slaughtered animal. The criterion for permissibility is whether the foetus has developed hair (a sign of sufficient development). This ruling reflects classical Islamic jurisprudence on the permissibility of consuming animals that reach a certain stage of development at the time of their mother's slaughter.
